## Purpose
`/workflows/new`: choose how to create a workflow (AI planner, visual builder, or copy an existing one), with illustrations, recent planning runs and an at-a-glance summary.

## Responsibilities
`NewWorkflowPage`:
- reads `workflowsApi.list` (for the copy option);
- `PathCard`s, with SVG art (`SvgNode`, `Edge`, `PlannerArt`, `BuilderArt`, `MiniFlow`, `CopyArt`);
- `PlanningRunRow` for the recent planner runs (`stores/runs`);
- `AtAGlance`;
- the heading "How do you want to …".

Titled "New workflow — Agentic AI Design Patterns".

## Key elements
`NewWorkflowPage`.

- **Links to** `/workflows/new/ai` and `/workflows/new/visual` (with `?copy=`).
